Noah (Sales): New POC request from MeridianCorp - fully air-gapped. Key asks: monthly security patches, emergency USB hotfix process, signed bundles with SBOM, and HSM-based key attest. They want a fixed per-patch line item and SOW language.
Ivy (Solutions): We should offer two ops patterns: 1) monthly delta bundles (USB-friendly) 2) quarterly full image + monthly deltas. Default USB cap = 1.5GB. For larger artifacts we do chunked delivery.
Sam (Security): Requirements checklist: SPDX SBOM per bundle, detached signature (.sig), offline verifier, and key custody statement. If Redwood keeps signing keys customer will request attestation and rotation logs.
Diego (Eng): Technical notes: incremental deltas need the previous runtime state (KV cache) to avoid cold restarts. Verifier binary validates manifest + SBOM hashes + detached sig. Works offline.
packbot: Uploaded artifact: artifacts/offline/1849994321/meridian-sealed-v1.tar.gz SHA256: c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff001122334455aa
Lena (Ops): Ops SOW bullets: estimated apply window 45-90 mins for typical deltas; retention of last 3 bundles on node; rollback preserved for 48-72 hrs. Customer supplies transfer media and chain-of-custody SOP.
Noah (Sales): Pricing ask: they want a firm per-patch fee and a one-time sealed-bundle engineering charge. Ivy - can you propose line items?
Ivy (Solutions): Suggested items: (A) Sealed-bundle engineering (one-time) (B) Per-patch handling & signing fee (C) Emergency hotfix premium (D) Expedited SLA add-on (E) Onsite HSM/KMS integration PS. Will draft numbers.
Sam (Security): Note: if they require FIPS-only signing for bundle sigs we need a compliance validation — add 2-3 weeks lead. Call this out.
Diego (Eng): KMS note: for offline runtime unwraps we support PKCS#11 HSMs. Initial bootstrap needs ops/prof svc. Add optional PS line in SOW.
Lena (Ops): Also add SOW text: "Customer responsible for secure transport and media storage. Redwood delivers signed artifacts and offline verification tooling."
Noah (Sales): Action items: Ivy drafts SOW/pricing; Sam completes security questionnaire sections and attaches SBOM template; Diego builds verifier binary + manifest examples; Lena prepares ops runbook snippet. I'll confirm whether customer can accept chunked bundles.
Ivy (Solutions): Will send draft SOW tonight.
Noah (Sales): Thanks all. If any blocker (e.g., legal on key custody) flag here.
